none: PAS NLM-8DFB45: Early Medieval Coin: Penny of Edward the Confessor
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin. Penny of Edward the Confessor (1042-1066), Pax issue of 1042-1044, BMC iv, North volume 1 no. 813, probably moneyer Leofric at Stamford mint. Obverse description: Profile bust draped, mantled and diademed left with sceptre before face. Initial cross pattee. Obverse inscription: +EDPERDV REX AN. Reverse description: Voided cross with central annulet and a crescent at the end of each…
